content: Recommendation diversity. Figure FIGREF16 shows the diversity of the tag recommendation approaches. We achieve the highest diversity with the similarity-based approaches, which extract Amazon search terms. Their accuracy is, however, very low. Thus, the combination of the two vocabularies can provide a good trade-off between recommendation accuracy and diversity.
